This card seems to be working a little off.

I've played it twice, once with 4 players, once with 5. 

With 5 players, Guise only gained 1 hp.  With 4, he only gained 2 hp.  Both times he had under 20 hp.

As you discard the top card of every deck, the minimum HP gain (unless you're near max hp) should be 3.  With no incapped characters, the HP Gains should be 2+(H).  Unless i'm missing something.

Is anyone else having this issue?

Yeah, I had a guy, new to the game, play Guise because he loved Deadpool and played that card. Apparently "Target" means something different in the card games he was used to, so he was disappointed when he played it and got 0 HP back.

From what I can tell, best use of it is against The Matriarch, in the Final Wasteland, with a team of Unity and Captain Cosmic (and maybe Visionary).

Or in Realm of Discord while Imbued Vitality is out.
